# WAS_ZINB_Model { #wass2s.WAS_ZINB_Model }

```python
WAS_ZINB_Model(
    nb_cores=1,
    dist_method='nonparam',
    alpha_init=0.2,
    add_intercept=True,
)
```

Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial (two-part, Dask-safe).

P(Y=0|X) = pi(X) + (1-pi(X)) * NB(y=0 | mu(X), alpha)
E[Y|X]   = (1 - pi(X)) * mu(X)
